text: The obstacle detection system shall detect objects at distances up to 2 meters.
The obstacle detection system shall publish obstacle distance measurements to the vehicle controller.
The lighting controller shall measure ambient light intensity.
The lighting controller shall activate the headlights when ambient light is below 100 lux.
The tire pressure monitoring system shall acquire tire pressure measurements.
The tire pressure monitoring system shall generate a warning when pressure falls below the configured threshold.
The parking assistance system shall detect obstacles at distances up to 1.5 meters.
The parking assistance system shall provide obstacle distance information to the driver warning controller.
The driver warning controller shall detect confirmed hazards.
The driver warning controller shall issue an audible warning within 200 milliseconds of hazard confirmation.
The rain sensor controller shall estimate rainfall intensity.
The wiper controller shall activate the wipers when rainfall exceeds the configured threshold.
The cruise controller shall maintain the requested vehicle speed within 2 km/h.
The cruise controller shall update the requested acceleration based on measured vehicle speed.
The battery monitor shall measure individual cell voltages.
The battery monitor shall report a cell voltage deviation when the difference exceeds 50 mV.
The door controller shall detect door state changes.
The door controller shall report an open-door event within 100 milliseconds.
The lane monitoring system shall determine the vehicle position relative to lane boundaries.
The lane departure controller shall issue a warning when a lane boundary crossing is detected.
The obstacle detection system shall process sensor measurements at 20 Hz.
The obstacle detection system shall reject obstacle measurements with invalid sensor quality flags.
The lighting controller shall sample ambient light at least every 100 milliseconds.
The tire pressure monitoring system shall update pressure status at least every 1 second.
The parking assistance system shall process proximity sensor measurements at 20 Hz.
The warning controller shall timestamp hazard confirmation events.
The cruise controller shall sample vehicle speed at least every 20 milliseconds.
The battery monitor shall sample cell voltage at least every 100 milliseconds.
The door controller shall sample door state at least every 20 milliseconds.
The lane monitoring system shall update lane position at least every 50 milliseconds.
